title: Asian-Style Quinoa Patties with Cabbage and Sesame
subtitle: with a soy and mirin dipping sauce
description: Crispy sesame-coated quinoa and cabbage patties served with a simple soy and mirin dipping sauce. The mixture needs 2 hours in the fridge to firm up.

steps.text: Rinse the quinoa and place in a pot with 180 ml water, the oil and salt. Bring to the boil, cover and cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Turn off the heat and wait about 10 minutes until the quinoa is cooked and white rings appear around the grains. Fluff with a fork and cool.
Blanch the cabbage in salted water for 5 to 7 minutes until soft but still slightly crisp. Drain, cool a little and chop finely.

Mix the cabbage in a bowl with the quinoa, 1 teaspoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon mirin, a few drops of sesame oil, half the garlic, fresh ginger, chilli, toasted sesame seeds, 3 sliced spring onions, eggs and breadcrumbs. Refrigerate for 2 hours to firm up.
Shape into flat patties about 4 cm across and coat in the sesame seeds. Fry in a thin layer of oil for 2 minutes on each side until golden. Drain on paper towel.
For the sauce, mix 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 3 tablespoons mirin, half a clove of crushed garlic, the pickled ginger and a little sliced spring onion. Serve alongside the patties.
